strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted scoring margin
strategies.signal: Hierarchical offense/defense scoring strength, opponent and venue adjustments; shrink early-season estimates.
strategies.required: Historical game outcomes; point distributions; timestamps; opening/closing offers; push rules
strategies.failure: Normal margins and constant variance are assumptions; integer pushes need a discrete score model.
strategies.correlation_method: Not a multi-leg strategy; residual dependence across games still affects uncertainty.

strategies.name: Pace–efficiency total
strategies.signal: Possession-count and points-per-possession distributions, opponent adjustment, rest and availability.
strategies.required: Official play-by-play or consistently defined possession data; game totals; weather; market totals
strategies.failure: A normal total is only an approximation; score discreteness, overtime and garbage time matter.
strategies.correlation_method: Model margin/total dependence from aligned game residuals, not season rankings.

strategies.name: Availability surprise
strategies.contract: Spread or total at a sealed information cutoff
strategies.signal: Compare starter/backup scenarios using only information available before the offer timestamp.
strategies.required: Immutable injury/depth/inactive history; snap shares; replacement performance; synchronized market quotes
strategies.failure: A DNP or blank game-status cell does not establish a replacement; news may already be priced.
strategies.correlation_method: Cluster uncertainty by game and team; do not treat repeated player/news rows as independent games.

strategies.name: Role redistribution player props
strategies.contract: Player yards/receptions/rushing attempts at operator line
strategies.signal: Project snap share, route/target share and carry share under verified availability scenarios.
strategies.required: Official snap/target/box-score history; player identity map; actual prop lines; DNP/void rules
strategies.failure: Backup quality is not a universal scalar; committee roles and game script change usage.
strategies.correlation_method: Estimate aligned hit-event phi and empirical joint rates by player/role/game context.

strategies.name: Cross-game parlay value
strategies.contract: Two or more separate game selections
strategies.signal: Compare exact joint win probability with the operator's offered parlay price after limits and fees.
strategies.required: Joint outcome panel or defensible dependence model; all leg prices; parlay payout and void rules
strategies.failure: Independence is not guaranteed; common weather/slate/model errors create dependence.
strategies.correlation_method: Game/date-block bootstrap; empirical joint rates when aligned; Fréchet bounds are not a point estimate.

strategies.name: Same-game script combination
strategies.signal: Simulate coherent game scripts and compare joint hit mass with the actual SGP offer.
strategies.required: Play-level or aligned game/prop outcomes; operator SGP price; exact settlement matrix
strategies.failure: Raw-stat Pearson r is not hit-event correlation; pairwise margins do not identify a three-leg joint.
strategies.correlation_method: Estimate joint outcome frequencies directly; report phi for binary legs and uncertainty by game.

strategies.name: Same-player multi-stat combination
strategies.contract: Same player's two or more stat thresholds
strategies.signal: Usage/minutes-equivalent snap share and game-script scenarios produce a joint discrete outcome distribution.
strategies.required: Aligned per-game stat lines, thresholds, player availability and combination settlement rules
strategies.failure: A rare combo can beat a naive 50% benchmark through base rates alone; that is not skill.
strategies.correlation_method: Binary hit phi, observed joint rate and paired bootstrap interval; preserve pushes/voids separately.

strategies.name: Teammate and team-total combination
strategies.contract: Two teammates or player plus team total
strategies.signal: Model shared possessions, target competition, rushing/passing mix and opponent defensive personnel.
strategies.required: Official player/team game logs; verified lineup/depth data; exact operator combo contract
strategies.failure: Teammate props can be positively or negatively dependent; do not hard-code a sign.
strategies.correlation_method: Fit and validate joint outcomes by game; compare with independent-product benchmark without assuming it.

competition.ranking: Descending lower 95% date-block bootstrap bound on net return per unit, only after all gates pass
competition.policy: Same future window, eligible-offer universe, settlement rules, scored-event hash and flat paper-stake policy in each division. Log every abstention and failed attempt. No real-money execution or cash reward is enabled.

correlations.scope: Aligned NFL game outcomes at specified operator thresholds
correlations.discovery: Collect a complete preregistered player/game window and exact thresholds; preserve voids/pushes.
Use stable player IDs and aligned game rows; estimate target competition versus game-script effects.

correlations.pair: QB passing + receiver receiving hit events
correlations.discovery: Collect paired box-score outcomes and actual combination lines; do not substitute raw-yard correlation.
Archive synchronized lines and final scores; model discrete pushes and overtime explicitly.
Use date-block resampling and a prospective outcome panel; do not assume independence from different kickoff times.
